summary: Warn before replication replay removes retained projections for blocked owned sets

replay.detail: Canonical replay behavior is unchanged. Estimates now name blocked owned sets and explain that their retained physical desired and mission-definition rows are removed without rebuilding them while blocked; authoritative claims and set receipts remain.

schema.detail: No schema or audit format changes.

rules.detail: No admission or graph rules change; no additional confirmation flag or refusal.

compatibility.detail: Replay estimates add blocked_owned_sets. Confirmed CLI replay prints an estimate warning to stderr before requesting the replay, preserving JSON stdout.

downtime.detail: Replay still requires a planned writer-maintenance window.

manual.detail: Resolve named owned-set blockers before replay if retained physical projection rows must remain available.

recovery.detail: Do not restart the daemon to fix a running replay.
